'''Attila''' was an [[Asteroid Hangar]] base used by [[Airam (group)|Airam]] [[Clan leader]] [[Tamaron]].

==History==
Originally a large [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] located in [[The Drift/Legends|The Drift]], it was converted into a Airam hanger base by clan leader [[Tamaron]]. After the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] saved personnel from an [[Retreat from Gallofree|attack]] lead by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] from [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force Vengeance]], Tamaron agreed to replenish the Alliance's [[Warhead/Legends|warhead]] supply and arranged a meeting at Attila. There a couple of his [[Cargo ferry|cargo ferries]] [[Charlie (cargo ferry)|''Charlie'']] and [[Tango (cargo ferry)|''Tango'']] and [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] ''[[Ignat]]'' arrived to conduct trading with Alliance ships such as Cargo ferries ''[[Orrian]]'' and ''[[Lundi]]'' and ''[[MC40a light cruiser/Legends|MC40a light cruiser]] [[Condor (MC40a light cruiser)|Condor]]''.

While [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue]] and [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] patrolled the area in [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]]. [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]] from [[Bravo Flight (New Republic)|Bravo Flight]], under the command of [[Ilay]] a rival clan leader and collaborator for the Empire arrived and started attacking the station. After the renegade Airam fighters were dispatched [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] along with Star Destroyer [[Wasp (Imperial-class)|''Wasp'']] arrived. In spite of Imperial forces bearing down on the meeting, all Airam [[Cargo ferry|Cargo ferries]] traded their Warheads to the Alliance and all ships would escape to [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]].
